basis: Cleft lip/palate affects oral structures; the facial-skeleton ancestor does not establish an additional skeletal disorder.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: the defining cleft is assigned to oral anatomy; no additional skeletal disease is established.

basis: Developmental disability, heart defects and hearing loss define the syndrome; camptodactyly 48/60 supports skeletal involvement. Hypermetropia 20/30 omitted by cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: congenital heart defects are explicitly defining; atrial septal defect occurs in 30/44.
decisions.otologic: primary: hearing impairment is explicitly defining and occurs in 23/28.

basis: Cutis laxa and arterial disease define ARCL1B; joint hypermobility 1/3 and skeletal malformations support musculoskeletal involvement. Emphysema 1/1 cannot establish typical frequency.

decisions.pulmonary: none: emphysema in one reported patient does not establish involvement in ≥30% of ARCL1B patients.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: joint hypermobility 1/3, arachnodactyly 2/2 and reported bone/chest malformations support common structural involvement; samples are small.

basis: Oxidative phosphorylation defect with defining CNS/liver dysfunction; amyotrophy 8/8 and arthritis 3/9 support muscle/joint involvement. Anemia 4/4 omitted by cap.

decisions.haematologic: none: anemia 4/4 qualifies, but is omitted under the four-axis cap in favor of muscle/joint involvement supported by larger samples.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: generalized amyotrophy 8/8 and arthritis 3/9 support common muscle/joint damage.

basis: Omphalocele is a congenital abdominal-wall closure defect with defining herniation of bowel; reported in 9/9.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: congenital bowel herniation is part of the defining structural lesion; intrinsic intestinal injury is not required for primary assignment.

basis: Glomus tumor arising in skin; dilated intratumoral veins do not establish additional cardiovascular disease.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: perivascular glomus cells and dilated intratumoral veins describe the skin tumor's histology, without independent cardiovascular involvement.

basis: CLPB-associated organic aciduria with core neurodevelopmental impairment (6/6) and blood-cell disease: neutropenia 5/6 and anemia 4/6.

decisions.haematologic: primary: neutropenia is a core blood-cell manifestation (5/6), with anemia in 4/6.
decisions.neurologic: primary: neurodevelopmental impairment is a core manifestation (6/6), accompanied by seizures and structural brain abnormalities.

basis: HHV8-associated sarcoma typically involving skin; endothelial differentiation does not establish additional cardiovascular disease. No individual visceral site reliably reaches 30%.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: vascular endothelial differentiation alone does not establish additional disease of the heart or native vessels.

basis: Skeletal defects, cleft palate and severe intellectual disability are core; defining deafness supports otologic involvement. Heart defects omitted by cap; cases are very few.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: congenital heart defects qualify as defining, but are omitted under the cap; severity is unspecified, whereas deafness is established functional loss.
decisions.otologic: involved: deafness is an explicitly defining feature and represents lasting auditory dysfunction; numerical frequency is unavailable.

basis: Inherited tubulointerstitial nephropathy with renal insufficiency and concentrating defects; hyperuricemia reflects abnormal renal urate handling.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hyperuricemia is a manifestation of the renal urate-handling defect; an independent metabolic disorder is not established.
